授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（日本語）: この授業は、将来の学術研究に応用できる中級レベルの特定の発信スキルを発展させることを目的とする。この授業はスキルに焦点を当てた授業であり、学修目的に合わせて、ディベート、ディスカッション、オーラル・コミュニケーション、プレゼンテーション、ライティング、テスト・テイキングなど様々なスキルから授業を選択することができる。
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）:
This course is designed to develop students’ intermediate levels of specific productive skills that can be applied in their future academic research. This is a skill-based course that provides students with opportunities to choose a skill that suits their learning purposes from among diverse topics, including debate, discussion, oral communication, presentation, writing, test-taking, etc.
---
The "Academic English: Skill-Based (Documentary Production)" course is designed to help students improve their language skills through project-based learning. Students watch videos of interviews with people working in Japan, and also analyse short documentaries from around the world to spark ideas for their own individual mini documentaries. Over eight weeks, students are guided to create a plan for their 5-minute documentary, including preparing a storyboard and shot list. At the end of the course, the mini documentaries are screened to the whole class. Students develop soft skills through interviewing subjects of their choice, language skills through writing their script and adding subtitles, and technical skills through editing their video and adding audio-visual effects.
This course, Skill-Based (Documentary Production), is related to the Skill-Based (Subtitling) course in the fall quarter. For a brief introduction to film-making you may register for just one course, but for a more in-depth experience it is recommended that you take both courses.

授業科目の実施方法について.備考:
この授業は8週で１単位のクォータ科目です。単位認定には、最低45時間の学習時間のうち、１週あたり3.5時間程度の事前・事後学習を含みます。This is a quarter course which credits one unit for attending 8 lessons (weeks). To fulfill the credit requirement, students are expected to work a minimum of 45 hours. Homework may include approximately 3.5-hour pre-class assignments and post-class comprehension activities.

授業科目の成績評価の方法について.出席:
Attendance
• Attendance will be taken each lesson.
• Attending class is important, but even more important is active participation. Therefore, you may be considered absent or get marks deducted:
o If you are late.
o If you come to class, but you do not participate in the activities (e.g. you do something else instead of class work).
• To succeed in this course, come to class every week, do all the work in class, complete all the assignments after class, and sit for all the tests.
• If you are absent 1 time (8-week quarter course) or 3 times (16-week semester course), I will give you a warning.
• If you are absent more than 2 times (quarter course) or 5 times (semester course) without a valid excuse, you will probably fail the course.
• There’s no need to inform me if you miss class.
• However, if you want to be officially excused, you can email me. Make sure to include the reason and documented evidence with dates.
• Your absence will be officially excused if I accept your reason and reply to your email saying so.
